Authors: Christian Melcher, Andreas Nenning, Stanislaus Breitwieser, Kirsten Rath, Luca Balice, Jonathan Rollenitz, Martin Bram, Christoph Rameshan, Alexander Karl Opitz

In situ Auger–Meitner electron microscopy reveals voltage-driven morphological evolution in solid oxide cell electrodes.

item.title: Robust NO x self-monitoring of a ZnO/(La, Sr)CoO 3 nanoarray monolith during catalytic NO oxidation
item.description:
Authors: Chunxiang Zhu, Jiyu Sun, Bo Zhang, Xingxu Lu, Fangyuan Liu, Usman Salahuddin, Pu-Xian Gao

ZnO/LSCO nanoarray monolith reactor robustly self-monitors sub-ppm and ppm level NO x during its catalytic NO oxidation process.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ta03884k

item.title: Dynamic control of uniform manganese electrodeposition by programmable current waveforms
item.description:
Authors: Haidong Zhong, Yang Song, Kang Tang, Jie Liang, Tingting Hu, Jun Du, Changyuan Tao, Qian Zhang

Programmable nonlinear current waveforms decouple interfacial kinetics and ion diffusion. Sine and dualtone currents improve current efficiency from 81.2% to 85.2% and 87.0%, for high-performance electrocrystallization.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ta06617h

Identification of key descriptors for C–C coupling on dual-atom catalysts
item.description:
Authors: Peiqi Qiu, Ling Chen, Rahman Daiyan, Yan Jiao

The d-band center, Δ G (*CHO), Δ G (*CO), and metal Bader charge govern C–C coupling thermodynamics in dual-atom catalysts, while the interatomic distance ( d (M–M)) between metal centers acts as a secondary descriptor that regulates these primary descriptors.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ta05851e

item.title: Accelerating OH desorption in bimetallic HER electrocatalyst for anion exchange membrane water electrolysis
item.description:
Authors: Vipin Yadav, Vanshree Parey, Ayush Kumar Shaw, Sreelakshmy Thekkekara, Bhargav Rajbongshi, Rajashri Urkude, Sudip Chakraborty, M. M. Shaijumon

Ru–Co bimetallic nanocluster accelerate alkaline hydrogen evolution by promoting water dissociation and relieving OH poisoning of Ru sites.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ta05206a

item.title: Multistep screening of asymmetric heterotrimetallic triple-atom catalysts for the conversion of HFC-152a to vinylidene fluoride: a combined DFT and machine learning study
item.description:
Authors: Dang-guo Cheng, Wucan Liu, Xiang Sun, Wei Zhang, Junxing Wang, Wanjin Yu, Fengqiu Chen

Mechanism-guided AI-DFT screening of 632 asymmetric heterotrimetallic triple-atom catalysts identifies Ni 1 Pt 1 Ti 1 /SNC as promising for oxidative conversion of HFC-152a to vinylidene fluoride via cooperative O 2 activation and sequential H transfer.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ta07004c

item.title: Intermediate-mediated anion tuning of AgIn(S,Te) 2 nanorods for highly efficient NIR-II photoluminescence
item.description:
Authors: Ga Yeon Kwon, Doheon Yoo, Jong Chan Byun, Jea Woong Jo, Jongmin Choi, Min-Jae Choi

An intermediate-mediated anion-tuning strategy was developed to retain residual sulfide within AgIn(S,Te) 2 nanorods. The resulting nanorods showed suppressed nonradiative recombination with a NIR-II PLQY of 62.0% after ZnS surface passivation.

DOI: 10.1039/d6ta04603g
